name: fish
desc: fish with a rod from a bank (crafts the rod from 3 sticks + 2 string if you have string); finds water within 16 m, casts, waits for the bite, reels in

cooldown.text: cannot fish here: no fishing rod (needs 2 string + 3 sticks) or no water within 40 m
cooldown.hint: string comes from spiders and cobwebs; without it use get_food hunt or explore_and_return to find a pond

steps.desc: walk until water is within 16 m
bank, cast, wait for the bite, reel
